videos.title: I ran an experiment: Fable vs Astra #AI #Fable5 #GPT6 #Astra
videos.description:
I ran a simple experiment. One prompt, the same brief, handed to two different models, and I sat back to see what each would build. The task was the copy-paste problem everyone lives with, and what came back genuinely surprised me.

Fable built a thing called Ledge. A narrow list that slides in from the right edge of the screen, tight and out of the way. Astra went a completely different direction and built Shelf, a wide bar across the bottom with big cards and a preview pane, much more visual.

items.title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

items.description:
Business Value
With a Subgrid optimized for mobile, frontline workers will experience click reduction and faster field workflows. Enhancements to the Subgrid control include top‑level Add New and Use/Complete all action buttons, bulk‑add functionality, barcode scanning, and inline editing to speed record management on the go.
Feature Details
Field Service Mobile is improving the existing Service Task View, Service View, and Product View Subgrid controls to provide a faster, touch-first way for t

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
items.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
items.description: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Coordinated meetings support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
items.description:
IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.
This roadmap item is no longer accurate and is being removed from the Public Roadmap, we apologize for the inconvenience.
#Education

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and co

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
items.description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Insights: Copilot Analytics - Cowork adoption and impact
items.description: Deeper insights into Cowork adoption and impact accessible from the new AI Cost dashboard and Copilot dashboard. Includes export capability. All metrics can be queried by analysts with the new AI cost query in advanced insights.

items.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
items.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

items.title: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
items.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

items.title: OneDrive: Document library views now available in OneDrive
items.description: Users can now work with SharePoint document library views directly from OneDrive. In addition to switching between existing views, users can create and manage views to customize how library content is organized and displayed. This helps teams surface the information that matters most while staying within the OneDrive experience.

items.title: Outlook: Co-Authoring Highlight and Rewrite
items.description: Users can now collaborate with Copilot to make improvements to email drafts. Select a section of the draft and ask Copilot to make changes, like changing its length, tone, or structure.

items.title: Access: Cascading combo and list boxes with LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields
items.description: Combo boxes and list boxes now support LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields properties, enabling cascading dropdowns (e.g., Country filters City) without writing VBA code.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
items.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description:
Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
items.description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint file
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, screenshots of tables in Excel, or whiteboard photos in PowerPoint — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
items.description: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
items.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
items.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
items.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention capabilities based on files Last Accessed in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Ability to apply Retention labels and policies to items on OneDrive and SharePoint based on when the items were last accessed by an user.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
items.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
